desc_assistant: Talks with you, splits work into tasks and hands them out. The one conversation you wait on for a reply.
desc_agent_new: The agents that do the tasks on your computers. A task can still be given its own model when it starts.
desc_kb: Text work nobody waits on: translation, reply drafts, titles and organizing the knowledge base.
desc_inbox_triage: Sorts and summarizes what comes into the Inbox and judges its importance. The same model reads why an agent stopped and judges what the AI twin takes up. Many small calls.
desc_agent_delegate: Decides whether an agent's question is yours to answer, and answers the ones that are not. A wrong answer goes straight to the agent.
desc_inbox_agent: The AI twin's runs: an agent handles an Inbox item and drafts the reply for you to send.
desc_lark_agent: Agents you start by sending /agent in Lark.
desc_inbox_judge: Judges whether the AI twin should take up an Inbox item.
desc_agent_triage: Reads why an agent stopped: finished, waiting on something, or needing you.
desc_inbox_draft: Drafts a reply for you to review and send.
desc_kb_compress: Compresses long chats and tags them for the knowledge base.
desc_kb_project: Rewrites a project's file in the knowledge base from what was learned since.
desc_kb_dedupe: Finds knowledge-base projects that are the same one.
desc_kb_items: Extracts items from chats and tags them.
desc_kb_moments: Links Moments posts to what the knowledge base already holds.
desc_assistant_route: Decides whether a new chat belongs to a direction or is a quick chat.
desc_agent_title: Names an agent's tab from what it is working on.
desc_subscription_recipe: Drafts how a source subscription fetches its content.
desc_suggest_next: Suggests the next message for chats that don't make one themselves (Persona's own, Codex and other agents), from their last few messages. Only while "Suggest the next message" is on; one small call per reply.
desc_meeting_answer: Answers questions asked in a meeting Persona attends, from the meeting's material only.
desc_schedule: Scheduled tasks, such as the morning briefing, run as Persona's own conversations.
desc_assistant_supervise: Follows up and reviews the tasks Persona hands out, so the main chat stays free to answer you: it reads their signals, checks the evidence and sends work back. Nobody waits on it.
use_titles: Chat titles, agent tab names and todo titles
use_reply_or_agent: Deciding whether to reply or hand to an agent
source_auto: Automatic (a connection the hub can call directly)
status_no_api: No model is configured for this API purpose. Add a connection with a key or choose a Claude Code launcher in Settings › Model providers
status_codex_no_api: No model is configured for this API purpose. Codex can’t run these requests because its tools can’t all be disabled. Add a connection with a key or choose a Claude Code launcher in Settings › Model providers
err_not_callable: The hub can’t call this provider’s API directly
err_provider_type: Provider must be a string or null
err_field_type: Model fields must be strings or null
err_field_invalid: Model fields can’t be empty or contain line breaks
err_no_database: No database, so the model config can’t be saved
err_conflict: The config was changed. Reload, then save
err_provider_unsupported: This provider doesn’t support this use
err_extension_model: The extension doesn’t have this model
err_launcher_not_on_machine: The computer this use runs on doesn’t have this launcher
err_agent_launcher: Agents can only start with a Claude Code or Codex launcher
err_codex_effort: A new Codex’s reasoning effort is set by its launcher. Switch back to inherited
err_purpose_readonly: This use’s model is read-only. Change its category’s model instead
err_api_effort: This API connection doesn’t support reasoning effort
triage_in_use: These extensions use “Message triage” to sort the inbox: {names}. Turn them off in Settings › Extensions before changing this model
err_api_as_launcher: This use points to a direct API connection that cannot run as a launcher
err_runtime_invalid: Runtime must be cli or agentsdk
err_runtime_assistant_only: Only the main chat can choose a runtime
use_delegate: Deciding whether to answer an agent's question for you
source_auto_named: Automatic: {provider} (a connection the hub can call directly)
err_model_invalid: Model ID {model} can’t be used: it must start with a letter or digit (or ~ and then one) and have only letters, digits and . _ - / : @ [ ], up to 256 characters
custom_model_description: A model ID you used before
err_role_forget: Full access is required to forget a model ID.
err_via_offline: {name} is offline. This connection sends its requests through it: bring it online, or choose another computer under Send through in Settings › Model Providers
err_run_no_machine: This provider runs on the main chat’s computer, and none is set: choose one in Settings › Assistant
err_run_offline: {name} is offline. This use runs {launcher} there: bring it online, or choose another provider in Settings › Model configuration
err_run_logged_out: {launcher} isn’t logged in on {name}: log in there, or choose another provider in Settings › Model configuration
